EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yeah, I've got a lot of cool stuff in

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Chez moi, c'est une véritable salle

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sì, ci sono un sacco di cose

{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:000F:0005:00002800}}
OK!
No, grazie.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich hab schon einige tolle Sachen
in meiner Bude, oder?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0016:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Hey!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Wenn du irgendwas findest,

Okay!
Nein danke.

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Evet, evimde bayağı havalı eşya var,

Tamam!
Yok, sağ ol.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Hey!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} You looked like you were just

attention, right? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Yes!
Nope!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}¡Oye!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Te has quedado con la

¡Sí!
¡No!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Qu'est-ce qui t'arrive ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} L'espace
d'un instant, tu avais l'air d'être

{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Quelque chose dans ma déco a

{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
En effet !
Rien à voir !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Ehi!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Hai una faccia... Sei su un altro

Sì!
No!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Hey!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Du machst ja echt Stielaugen!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Irgendwas in meiner Bude gefällt dir
richtig gut, oder? Du liebäugelst
doch mit irgendwas, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Richtig!
Nein.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Hey!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Dalgın dalgın boşluğa bakıyormuşsun
gibi duruyordun!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Evimde bir şey dikkatini
çekti, değil mi? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Evet!
Hayır!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}You'd like to design your home
based on mine, right?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}For you, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, I might be able
to part with some of this stuff.{{TAG:000F:0005:00002800}}
Really?!
Not interested.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Te gustaría rediseñar tu casa
basándote en la mía, ¿no?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Por ser tú, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, a lo mejor
podría desprenderme de parte
de estas cosas.{{TAG:000F:0005:00002800}}
¡¿De verdad?!
No me interesa
FR:

suis prêt à me séparer de certains
objets s'ils te font envie.{{TAG:000F:0005:00002800}}
Vraiment ?!
Je n'ai besoin de rien.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ti piacerebbe arredare casa tua
come la mia, vero?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Solo per te, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, potrei
decidere di separarmi da uno
dei miei oggetti.{{TAG:000F:0005:00002800}}
Davvero?!
Non mi interessa.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Du willst, dass deine Bude genauso

{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:000F:0005:00002800}}
Im Ernst?!
Nein danke.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Kendi evini benimkine bakarak tasarlamak

için, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, bu eşyalardan
bazılarıyla vedalaşabilirim.{{TAG:000F:0005:00002800}}
Gerçekten mi?!
İlgilenmiyorum.

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Tu n'as vraiment rien vu qui

couleurs, hein...

{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Well, if you don't want anything, you
don't want anything{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} That's fine
with me!
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}But I'd hate to see you walk away

{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Bueno, si no quieres nada, ¿qué se le

arrepintieras, ¿eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} So do you have something in
mind, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh ?!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Et qu'est-ce qui t'a tapé dans

DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Und hast du auch schon
was im Blick, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}OK!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Well, tell me about it then!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} This

TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Tamam!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Hadi anlat o zaman!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Şimdi kendini

EN: {{TAG:0003:0026:}}Really!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Just tell me what you want!

{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Puisque je te le dis !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu as repéré

{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Dico davvero!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Dimmi che cosa
ti piace!

{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Aber klar doch!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Sag mir einfach,

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}OK! Show me what you like!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} If it's

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Vas-y, montre-moi l'objet de toutes

but if you see something you like,

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}No todo lo que hay aquí está en
